= Code cross-reference footnotes
:source-highlighter: rouge
:highlight-css: class
:name: Éva

[[target]]
== Target

[source,rust,subs=+macros]
----
xref:target[Before footnote:code[Code note.] after]
xref:target[Before footnote:code[] after]
xref:target[footnote:[Note-only label.]]
----

[source,rust,linenums,subs=+macros]
----
xref:target[Before footnote:[Numbered note.] after]
----

[subs=+macros]
....
xref:target[Before footnote:[Literal block note.] after]
....

[source,rust,subs="specialchars,macros,attributes,quotes,replacements"]
----
xref:target[Before footnote:[{name} *literal* (C).] after]
----

[source,rust,subs="specialchars,attributes,quotes,replacements,macros"]
----
xref:target[Before footnote:[{name} *bold* (C).] after]
----

[source,rust]
----
xref:target[Before footnote:[Disabled note.] after]
----

[source,rust,subs="verbatim,-macros"]
----
xref:target[Before footnote:[Explicitly disabled note.] after]
----
